name: Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of carbon-related products and services in Japan. It offers graphite electrodes for use in electric furnaces, such as direct current, alternating current, and refining furnaces; and carbon black, including SEAST, TOKABLACK, Aqua Black, and Thermax black varieties, which are used to reinforce the rubber in tires, as well as used as a black pigment in various black-colored products. The company provides fine carbon products comprising special graphite products that include isotropic graphite G/HK series, extruded graphite, SiC coated carbon, C/C composite, glassy carbon, solid SiC, carbon brushes, and resin-impregnated graphite product…
